paras: Celestus barbouri, also known commonly as Barbour's galliwasp and the limestone forest galliwasp, is a species of lizard in the family Diploglossidae. The species is endemic to Jamaica.
The specific name, barbouri, is in honor of American herpetologist Thomas Barbour.
C. barbouri is found in central and northern Jamaica.
The preferred natural habitat of C. barbouri is forest, at altitudes of 600 m (2,000 ft) and higher.
Moderate-sized for its genus, C. barbouri has a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of about 10 cm (3.9 in).
